# Sober Coach
> Sober Coach is an AI-powered recovery support app for adults returning home from drug or alcohol treatment and the families who support them.

## Primary page
- [Sober Coach](https://sobercoach.app/): Product overview, safety approach, pricing, beta application, and common questions.

## Trust and support
- [Privacy Policy](https://sobercoach.app/privacy.html): How Sober Coach collects, uses, protects, and shares data.
- [Terms of Service](https://sobercoach.app/terms.html): Terms governing use of the app and related services.
- [Account Deletion](https://sobercoach.app/delete-account.html): How users can delete their account and associated data.
- [Contact](mailto:admin@sobercoach.app): Product and support inquiries.

## Key facts
- Sober Coach provides 24/7 AI-assisted reflection and daily recovery check-ins.
- The product is designed to complement, not replace, professional treatment, peer support, sponsors, or emergency care.
- Family updates require permission from the person in recovery.
- Sober Coach is currently accepting applications for a closed beta.
